headline: German Investor Sentiment Rises to 35.6 in November, Beating Expectations
summary: The ZEW Economic Sentiment Index for Germany rose to 35.6 points in November from 28.1 in October, surpassing consensus estimates of 28.3.
why: The ZEW survey measures institutional investor and analyst sentiment regarding Germany's economic outlook over six months.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: ZEW economic confidence indicator beat analyst consensus forecasts.
